about: The ground of the map (AI-written, 11 November 2026): a few kinds of role and a few kinds of tie. A role is a place in a tie, not a thing: one thing can fill two roles. A tie kind has two ends and can hold between whatever roles a theorem speaks of. A theorem's sentence in cards.json uses these words and its model's own terms only; a case in cases.json uses its own words; a bridge pairs the two. The Chinese names are AI-written and wait for the director's ear. The marks are the root's four (01 section 3), each said with its sameness and its extent; the forms are what a theorem can conclude besides a mark; the frames say what a case must supply to meet a theorem. The ways in pair a question in plain words with the ties to start at; they are a reader's index, not a result.

roles.account: formation 形成; pattern 样式
roles.is: Anything that goes on as the same in some respect: a formation, a whole, a pattern carried by brief carriers, a line of descent, a practice.
What it is made of or carried by, which can turn over while it goes on.

roles.account: condition 缘 with a level; reserve
roles.is: Something with a level that is drawn on and given to: what something lives on, a reserve, a loss counted as it grows.

roles.account: renewal 更新; giving 给予
roles.is: What gives to a stock, from inside or from beyond.
What takes from a stock: one, the others, or all together.
What needs a stock at some level, whether or not it draws on it.

roles.account: selection 选择; order; act law
roles.is: What a choosing goes by: a selection, an order over outcomes, a quota, a score.

roles.account: carriers and the others; the share 份额; candidates
roles.is: What a rule picks among: the carriers of what it favours and the rest, with the share of each.

roles.account: readers 读者; pool 池; couplings
roles.is: What a rule or a reading is read through: a pool, a group, the couplings into it.
What something holds of what it meets: a view, a prediction, a rank, a code from senses to forms.

roles.account: what a reading is of; the standard it is read against
roles.is: What a reading is of, or the standard it is read against.
No role named: a theorem about every course, every process or every relation. These are the map's legend, not a place on it.

ties.account: carrying renewal 传; keeping 守
ties.is: It goes on while its parts turn over (passes on), or with the same parts (keeps).
Takes from a stock, step by step, against what comes back.

ties.account: renewal 更新; giving 给予
ties.is: Gives to a stock; how it answers the level (at once, late, only above a need).

ties.account: dependence 依存; need; margin 余裕; point of no return
ties.is: Depends on a stock at a need; the margin above it; the point past which the level does not come back.

ties.account: giving that waits on giving; mutual need 相须
ties.is: One's giving waits on another's: a directed tie of any shape (a pair, a chain, a ring).
The rule picks among them and favours some. Where it keeps favouring what it picked, that is the lock.

ties.account: read from the share it selects (ReadsShare); formed from
ties.is: Where the rule comes from: from outside, from the share of what it selected, against it, from its members.

ties.account: readers drawn from the selected; the pool
ties.is: Through what the rule or reading is read, and where those readers are drawn from.

ties.account: couples into 耦合进; reach 及; beyond
ties.is: A difference in one thing couples into another, or lies beyond it. The receiving end can be a rule, its readers, a reading, or another level.

ties.en: is of, and accords or misses
ties.is: The reading accords with what it is of, or misses; what it can and cannot tell apart.
The reading is revised by what comes back from what it acted on or met.
Whether anything passes between a part and the rest across a step.

marks.is: comes to hold where it did not
goes on holding, under the sameness named
goes on as the same and differs from step to step

forms.en: where these hold, that begins, lasts, changes or ends
exactly where the line falls, most often one amount or time at least another
unmoved by: two courses differing only there go alike
an order is kept: one amount or set is no more, or no less, than another
the same as, in another model
read backward: what holding it shows

frames.needs: a single run, read step by step

frames.en: two courses that differ in one thing
frames.needs: two runs alike but for that thing

frames.en: the best of what is open
frames.needs: a further claim that the actual system is at that best
nothing of a case: it is the legend
nothing: it shows what can happen

ways_in.ask: what happens to something many draw on: a commons, a budget, a base of support
how a reward, a judge, a market or a vote comes to lock on what it already picked
what never reaches a rule, and through what a rule is read
how a prediction or a model stands to what happens, and what revises it
how something lasts while its members change, and chains of giving that wait on one another
